date.as_written: samvat 538 vaiśākhaśuklapūrnnamāsyā (!) titho (!) | svātinakṣatre | vyatipātajoge (!) | budhavāsare

notes: The colophon names no persons: no scribe, commissioner or king. The era is not stated but is taken to be Nepāla Saṃvat, since the script is Newari and the catalogue gives NS 538. 538 + 880 gives c. 1418 CE (Vaiśākha pūrṇimā, so about April/May 1418). I have not verified the weekday, nakṣatra or yoga. 'yogacakrahorāṣṭakaṃ cchāyasāstra' should be read as Yogacakra-Horāṣṭaka, a chāyāśāstra. 'tadā dinalitasiddhaṃ' is probably a corruption of 'tadā dine likhitaṃ siddham' ('copying completed on that day'). 'sūdhaṃ vā masuvā kṣemasi' is a corrupt form of the usual 'śuddhaṃ vā aśuddhaṃ vā kṣantavyam' formula. It is not a personal name.
